input.command: git status --short --branch && git remote -v && git log -5 --oneline
git diff --check && git diff -- impl.ts artifacts/notes.md && git status --short

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md <<'EOF'
<decision>
Used exact elapsed UTC milliseconds for both thresholds, charged only the nonnegative unpaid balance, and rounded the percentage result to integer cents. Calendar-day arithmetic and truncating fractional cents were set aside because the ticket specifies 24-hour periods and the return type is cents.

<risk>
The ticket does not define a rounding rule; reviewers should confirm that nearest-cent rounding matches billing policy.

<verified>
Ran `node smoke.ts`, six focused assertions covering both time boundaries, partial-cent rounding, and overpayment, plus `git diff --check`.
EOF

lateFeeCents -> NaN
